items.heading: Line Up Every Placed Student
items.text: Line Up Every Placed Student Line Up Every Placed Student Line up every placed student from the lowest salary to the highest. The student standing in the exact middle has the median CTC. LPA means lakh per annum, and one lakh is 1,00,000 rupees.

items.heading: The Middle Student
items.text: The middle student: this is the median.

items.heading: The College Counts That Student
items.text: The College Counts That Student The college counts that student as placed. The usual test is an accepted offer. Some colleges also count internships or stipend-only roles, so ask what counts.

items.heading: A Company Offers a Job
items.text: A company offers a job through the college. The company visits the campus or runs an online drive for the college. A student who clears the tests and interviews gets an offer.

items.heading: The Placement Percentage Divides Placed
items.text: The placement percentage divides placed students by a group. The group can be the whole batch, the students eligible for placements, or only the students who registered. The bigger the group, the lower the percentage.

figures.label: Pay Range
figures.source: A college then charges Rs 9 lakh in all, with a branch median of Rs 4.2 lakh CTC and Rs 3.6 lakh of fixed pay inside it. That fee is three times the Rs 3 lakh line, and before tax and PF it equals two and a half years of fixed pay.
